summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Telix Pharmaceuticals Ltd to disclose an FDA alignment for its ProstACT Global Phase 3 trial of TLX591-Tx. The filing describes a Type B meeting outcome, safety data review, and protocol alignment for Part 2 of the study. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation corporate event is announced. The disclosure is a routine regulatory update on a clinical trial progress, not a special situation under event-driven analysis.
